about.title: About Wafi Dental Care
about.subtitle: Professional dental clinic in Yogyakarta with the motto #OnPointDentist
about.storyContent: Wafi Dental Care was founded with a vision to provide high-quality, transparent, and trustworthy dental health services for the people of Yogyakarta and surrounding areas. We believe every patient deserves the best dental care with clear, surprise-free pricing.
about.storyContent2: With a team of professional dentists experienced in various specialties, we are committed to continuously improving our service quality through continuous education and investment in the latest dental technology.
about.value1Desc: Every procedure is performed with high precision based on accurate diagnosis and measurable treatment plans.
about.value2Desc: Transparency in pricing is our commitment. Patients receive complete cost breakdowns before treatment begins.
about.value3Desc: Our team of doctors and staff always prioritize patient comfort with a warm and professional approach.
about.value4Desc: We use the latest medical equipment with international sterilization standards for maximum safety.
about.facility1Desc: Clean and comfortable waiting room with TV entertainment and free WiFi
about.facility2Desc: 4 modern dental units with complete equipment and high-standard sterilization system
about.facility3Desc: Medical equipment sterilization using autoclave and ultrasonic cleaner
about.facility4Desc: Equipped with dental X-ray for accurate and fast diagnosis
about.facility5Desc: Adequate parking for cars and motorcycles
about.facility6Desc: Team of doctors with various specializations to handle your dental needs
